lines.text: Before the Passover, Jesus loved His own to the very end, and the devil put betrayal into Judas's heart.
Jesus laid aside His outer garments, wrapped a towel around His waist, poured water into a jar, and washed feet.
Peter asked whether Jesus would wash his feet, then said, "Never shall You wash my feet!"
Peter asked Jesus to wash his hands and head as well, and Jesus said not all were clean.
Jesus said they should wash one another's feet, because no servant is greater than his king.
